issue_context.title: InfluxDB throws exception after argument none
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have been using InfluxDB integration for years, everything was working normally, after latest update, integration throws exceptions. 
I tried to upgrade everything on influx side, I am running 1.8.10 version, after starting the HASS, there are some data passed to influx, and working OK, however with some write request, integration throws exception. I tried to turn on debugging, but I still don't know which sensor or entity is causing this, so I could at least exclude it from sending it to influx. 


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2022.9.7 Supervisor 2022.09.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.8

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

InfluxDB

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/influxdb

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
influxdb:
  host: 192.168.1.245
  port: 8086
  database: hass
  username: hass
  password: pass
```

review_comments: This would be a bug in an integration if it happens. `None` should always be converted to `STATE_UNKNOWN` by the base Entity class before being set in the state machine.
